title: David Learns of Saul’s Death

questions.question: Who told David that Saul and Jonathan were dead?
questions.explanation: 2 Samuel 1:8 (ESV): "...I answered him, 'I am an Amalekite.'"

questions.question: What did the Amalekite bring to David?
questions.explanation: 2 Samuel 1:10 (ESV): "...and I took the crown that was on his head and the armlet that was on his arm..."

questions.question: How did David react to the news of Saul and Jonathan's death?
options: He tore his clothes and mourned
questions.correctAnswer: He tore his clothes and mourned
questions.explanation: 2 Samuel 1:11-12 (ESV): "Then David took hold of his clothes and tore them... and they mourned and wept and fasted until evening..."

questions.question: What did the Amalekite say he did to Saul?
questions.explanation: 2 Samuel 1:10 (ESV): "So I stood beside him and killed him, because I was sure that he could not live after he had fallen."

questions.question: What happened to the Amalekite messenger?
questions.explanation: 2 Samuel 1:15 (ESV): "Then David called one of the young men and said, 'Go, execute him.' And he struck him down so that he died."

questions.question: Where was David living when he heard the news?
questions.explanation: 2 Samuel 1:1 (ESV): "...David remained two days in Ziklag."

questions.question: What is the name of the lament David sang for Saul and Jonathan?
questions.explanation: 2 Samuel 1:18 (ESV): "and he said it should be taught to the people of Judah; behold, it is written in the Book of Jashar. He called it the Song of the Bow."

questions.question: According to David's lament, Saul and Jonathan were swifter than ______ and stronger than ______.
questions.explanation: 2 Samuel 1:23 (ESV): "...they were swifter than eagles; they were stronger than lions."

questions.question: Why did David order the Amalekite's execution?
questions.explanation: 2 Samuel 1:14 (ESV): "David said to him, 'How is it you were not afraid to put out your hand to destroy the LORD's anointed?'"

questions.question: In the lament, where did David say "let it not be heard"?
questions.explanation: 2 Samuel 1:20 (ESV): "Tell it not in Gath, publish it not in the streets of Ashkelon..."

questions.question: Which book is the Song of the Bow written in?
options: Book of the Wars of the Lord
questions.explanation: 2 Samuel 1:18 (ESV): "...behold, it is written in the Book of Jashar."

questions.question: What mountain did David curse in his lament?
questions.explanation: 2 Samuel 1:21 (ESV): "You mountains of Gilboa, let there be no dew or rain upon you..."

questions.question: What specific detail did the Amalekite mention about his location on Mount Gilboa?
options: He happened to be there by chance
He was sent as a scout
He was hiding in a cave
questions.correctAnswer: He happened to be there by chance
questions.explanation: 2 Samuel 1:6 (ESV): "...I happened to be on Mount Gilboa..."

questions.question: What condition was Saul in when the Amalekite found him?
questions.explanation: 2 Samuel 1:6 (ESV): "...and there was Saul leaning on his spear..."

questions.question: David said, "For the blood of the slain, the fat of the mighty, the bow of Jonathan ______."
questions.explanation: 2 Samuel 1:22 (ESV): "...the bow of Jonathan turned not back..."

key_verse_text: “How the mighty have fallen, and the weapons of war perished!” (ESV)
